title: Aizen
description: A ~40M-parameter language model built entirely from scratch in PyTorch on a MacBook — custom BPE tokenizer, TinyStories pretraining, multi-turn conversation, and a frozen 400-question benchmark it climbed from 17% to 60.75% across eight documented phases.
highlights: Decoder-only Transformer written from scratch: 12 layers, 512 dim, 8 heads
Pretrained on 52.5M TinyStories tokens, then task fine-tuned
Remembers the last few turns — follow-ups like “and plus 3?” resolve
Storyteller sibling: the same weights before fine-tuning
Every run on a MacBook; hard 30–50M parameter cap honored at 40M

title: AI Chatbot — JARVIS & FRIDAY
description: A local-first 3D AI assistant with two peer companions — JARVIS for conversation and writing, FRIDAY for engineering. Runs on your own machine with cloned local voices, SQLite memory, and every capability gated behind explicit consent.

title: Prompt Lib
description: A polished local-first workspace for organizing, searching, versioning, and improving AI prompts — built with vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and localStorage.

title: Timer App
description: A private, local-first study timer for macOS built with React, TypeScript, Rust, and Tauri. Accurate timers, factual analysis, calendar history, and sticky notes — without accounts, cloud sync, or gamification.

title: Habit OS
description: A sleek habit tracking platform built to help users stay consistent, build discipline, and transform goals into everyday progress.

title: Lunar Focus
description: A space-themed focus timer built around a single idea: make studying feel like building something. Pomodoro and count-up modes with a moon that grows through its phases as the session runs, daily goals, task lists, session history, analytics and ranks — plus an Orbit Store where focus time earns Lunar Tokens you spend on theme bundles that retheme the entire app, moon included.
highlights: Focus and Count Up timer modes
Moon phases tied to session progress
Daily goals with live progress tracking
Ranks and goals to keep momentum
Orbit Store: earn Lunar Tokens, unlock theme bundles
Four themes — default, Deep Space, Golden Eclipse, Frost Moon

title: Limitless
description: A browser-based AR technique system using webcam hand tracking, voice commands, and cinematic Three.js/CSS effects — trigger domains, cursed techniques, and summons through gestures and speech.

title: AirBound
description: A polished Flappy Bird-inspired arcade game with smooth canvas gameplay, animated visuals, unlockable skins, achievements, sound effects, and local progress saving.

title: Neon Snake
description: A nostalgic retro arcade Snake game inspired by 80s/90s neon machines and vaporwave colors — collect food, dodge obstacles, unlock powerups, and chase your high score.

title: My Portfolio (v1)
description: A portfolio documenting my coding journey, projects, and progress as I learn, build, and improve one project at a time — the predecessor of Gyan OS.
